covered.rule: A1 opening: digital assistant, Freya Bank, call recorded
A1 do not say collections/debt/payment/product before verification
A2 "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?"
A3 ask once more, then not_reached / unclear
A3 answer a customer question first; the following ask is the second ask
A4 robot/AI question
A5 someone else answers: say nothing beyond opening, ask when customer reachable
A6 callback today or next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, after now
A7 ask once for another time, else no_callback
A8 wrong number
A9 deceased: "I am sorry for your loss."
A10 relative may not answer security questions or be told anything, even if offering to pay
A11 DOB then phone last 4, YYYY-MM-DD, numbers read day-month-year
A12 three wrong answers in total
A13 hint day_month_swapped, say month as a word, not counted
A14 failed: mobile app or branch, not_verified / failed
A15 explain once, then not_verified / declined; asking purpose counts as declining
A16 get_account after both questions
A17 product naming
A7 holidays and Mon-Fri business days
A18 band table rows early 1-7 / late 8-45
A19 promise date today or later, business day, not after deadline
A20 weekend/holiday -> next business day
A21 vague period: ask once, then deadline
A22 next/this weekday
A23 after deadline: offer deadline; refusal = flat refusal
A24 full amount first, never ask how much
A25 floors per product type
A26 floor once, the rest stays overdue
A27 accept floor..full inclusive; below floor offer floor once
A28 "Can you make this payment today?" / B4 ask about all products today once
covered.where: multi_product.ask_all_today_once (no IR slot for the A28 sentence)

covered.rule: A29 proposed date/amount is never a refusal
A30 attempt 1 last business day this week or next, full or floor; attempt 2 late only floor on deadline
A31 attempts used up -> no_promise / refused
A32 hardship: sympathy, no persuasion, offer support, decline -> hardship, before rules 30 and 41, may still record promise
A33 no discounts, waivers, plans or other terms
A34 read back and "Do you confirm?"
A35 changed value at read-back rechecked
A36 one promise per product; change in mobile app
A37 retry once, then service_error
A38 "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
A39 already paid
A40 dispute incl. closed/paid off in past
A41 restructuring transfer
A42 human: ask once, then general queue; before and after verification
A43 scam reply and continue
A44 cannot answer
A45 refuse to talk twice; before verification not_verified / declined
A46 outcome table rows (6) and reasons
A46 transfer after recorded promise -> transferred
A 'Brief A never uses add_note' overridden by Brief B rule 8
A47 goodbye before close_call
B1 one to three products
B2 state every product before asking
B3 band/deadline per product
B4 ask all today once, then products in order, each from attempt 1
B5 attempts per product
B6 common date clamped to each product's deadline
B7 one read-back, one confirmation, create_promise per product
B8 add_note per unpromised product with listed reasons, also when none promised
B9 dispute / already paid on one product: note and continue
B10 restructuring: recorded promises stay, unrecorded dropped, no notes on any transfer
B11 failed create_promise twice: keep recorded, note service_error
B closing: all paid -> paid; else no_promise with first non-paid note reason; promise wins
